title: Multimodal Model Conversion
summary: This module handles the conversion of various multimodal models from their original formats to Hugging Face Transformers. It supports vision-language, object detection, document AI, and keypoint matching models.

nodes.label: Original Models
nodes.title: Original Models
nodes.description: Represents the diverse array of multimodal models from various sources and frameworks that are candidates for conversion.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Models
nodes.title: Hugging Face Models
nodes.description: The target format for all converted models, making them compatible with the Hugging Face ecosystem and tools.

nodes.label: General VLMs
nodes.title: General VLM Conversions
nodes.description: Converts foundational vision-language models such as ALIGN, BLIP, GIT, and GroupViT into the Hugging Face format.

nodes.label: Instructed VLMs
nodes.title: Instructed VLM Conversions
nodes.description: Handles the conversion of instruction-tuned vision-language models like InstructBLIP and Kosmos-2 for Hugging Face compatibility.

nodes.label: LLM-Integrated VLMs
nodes.title: LLM-Integrated VLM Conversions
nodes.description: Converts models that integrate large language models, including LLaVA, InternVL, Janus, OVIS-2, Phi-4 Multimodal, and Pixtral.

nodes.label: ViLT, VisualBERT, X-CLIP
nodes.title: ViLT & Related Conversions
nodes.description: Converts specific multimodal models including ViLT, VisualBERT, and X-CLIP to the Hugging Face standard.

nodes.label: SAM Models
nodes.title: SAM Model Conversions
nodes.description: Manages the conversion of Segment Anything Model (SAM) and its direct variants to the Hugging Face format.

nodes.label: Advanced SAM & Segmentation
nodes.title: Advanced SAM & Segmentation Conversions
nodes.description: Converts advanced SAM variants and other segmentation models like CHMv2 and EdgeTAM into the Hugging Face ecosystem.

nodes.label: Object Detection
nodes.title: Object Detection Conversions
nodes.description: Facilitates the conversion of various object detection models, including MM-Grounding-Dino, OWL-ViT, OWL-ViT v2, and OMDet-Turbo.

nodes.label: Keypoint Matching
nodes.title: Keypoint Matching Conversions
nodes.description: Converts models specialized in keypoint matching such as EfficientLoFTR, LightGlue, and SuperGlue.

nodes.label: Document AI
nodes.title: Document AI Conversions
nodes.description: Converts multimodal models tailored for document understanding tasks, including Donut, Nougat, Pix2Struct, and UDOP.

nodes.label: Depth Estimation
nodes.title: Depth Estimation Conversions
nodes.description: Handles the conversion of DepthPro, a model dedicated to depth estimation, into the Hugging Face format.

nodes.label: Model Architectures
nodes.title: Model Architectures Module
nodes.description: Provides core model building blocks and configurations utilized by conversion scripts.

nodes.label: Model Utilities
nodes.title: Model Utilities Module
nodes.description: Offers utility functions and helper methods for model operations and data handling.

nodes.label: Data Processing
nodes.title: Data Processing Module
nodes.description: Responsible for preprocessing and postprocessing data for various model types, ensuring compatibility.

nodes.label: Pipelines & Generation
nodes.title: Pipelines & Generation Module
nodes.description: Provides high-level interfaces for common tasks and sequence generation capabilities.

nodes.label: Quantization & Integrations
nodes.title: Quantization & Integrations Module
nodes.description: Manages model optimization techniques like quantization and integrations with external systems or tools.

nodes.title: Parent: model_conversion
nodes.description: The parent module responsible for general model conversion utilities and orchestration.

nodes.title: Sibling: image_conversion

nodes.label: Sibling: other_model_conversion
nodes.title: Sibling: other_model_conversion
nodes.description: Manages conversions for other miscellaneous model types.

nodes.label: Sibling: text_conversion
nodes.title: Sibling: text_conversion
nodes.description: Deals with conversions related to text-based models.

nodes.label: Sibling: audio_conversion
nodes.title: Sibling: audio_conversion
nodes.description: Focuses on conversions for audio models.

nodes.label: Sibling: gemma_family_conversion
nodes.title: Sibling: gemma_family_conversion
nodes.description: Handles conversions for the Gemma family of models.

nodes.label: Sibling: detr_family_conversion
nodes.title: Sibling: detr_family_conversion
nodes.description: Manages conversions for the DETR family of models.

groups.label: Segmentation & Detection
groups.title: Segmentation and Object Detection

groups.title: Specialized Vision Conversions
